response.sql: WITH per_circuit AS (SELECT c.circuitId AS circuitId, c.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country) SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / AVG(race_count * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS ratio FROM per_circuit ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Races are counted via an inner join to circuits, so races whose circuit is missing from circuits are excluded. The country average is taken over the per-circuit counts (each circuit weighted equally), not over races.
Ties in the ratio have no specified order, so which tied circuits fall within the top 10 is arbitrary.
